_comment: Ship-time SessionStart hook for pos-v2. On first run in a fresh clone, first-run.sh is a thin shim that detects Python 3.13, hands off to first_run_dispatch.py (stdlib), which spawns a detached first-run worker and returns in under a second. The worker handles venv creation, dependency installs, scaffolding, plist substitution, service bootstrap, and self-retires this stanza to invoke the sealed supervisor path on completion. See hands-off-lifecycle/README.md for the lifecycle. timeout is specified in seconds per Claude Code hook docs; 60s is a generous cap for the thin shim (which measurably returns in well under 1s) and is not the worker budget (the worker runs detached, past the hook's lifetime). async:false is deliberate — see docs/rebuild/FUTURE_IDEAS.md: the hook is thin enough that shell-level detach outperforms Claude Code's async flag and the handoff message needs to be surfaced as additionalContext synchronously.
